canyon.title: /api/admin/policies is reachable without a session
canyon.problem: There's no session check in the handler, and middleware.ts:22 leaves /api/admin/policies out of the matcher — so nothing upstream is checking either. Any caller without a session gets what this handler returns.
canyon.fix: Either add /api/admin/policies to the middleware matcher, or return early from the handler when the request has no cp_session cookie. The matcher is the safer of the two — it covers routes nobody's written yet.
canyon.required_end_state: /api/admin/policies answers only a request that carries a session: the middleware matcher covers it, or the handler returns before anything else when the session cookie is missing.
do_not: check a query parameter or header the caller sets instead of the session cookie
move the handler's logic to another route outside the matcher
add an ignore comment or suppression pragma
